relationships.subject: (+)-Catechin
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis further demonstrates that ( +)-catechin significantly reduces the protein expression of IBA-1, IL-1β, MyD88, p-NF-κB, p-JNK, p-ERK, p-p38MAPK, COX-2, and TLR4 within the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: CCI
relationships.evidence_quote: CCI induces the upregulation of nNOS, iNOS, IL-1β, and COX-2 within the rat sciatic nerve

relationships.subject: (+)-Catechin
relationships.evidence_quote: Overall, these findings suggest that ( +)-catechin alleviates neuropathic pain by modulating the M1 and M2 phenotypes of microglia through the TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB pathway.

key_findings: (+)-Catechin reduced CCI-induced mechanical hyperalgesia and spinal TLR4, MyD88, p-NF-κB and COX-2 expression, shifting microglia from M1 to M2.
